name: Thanh Le-Cong
title: Assistant Professor
university: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
bio: Thanh Le-Cong is an Assistant Professor at the ISTD Pillar, Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD). He received his PhD from the University of Melbourne in 2026 under the supervision of Dr. Bach Le and Prof. Toby Murray. His research focuses on Software Engineering, especially AI-based Software Engineering and Software Security. He particularly focuses on developing trustworthy AI systems for building reliable and secure software. His research has been published in leading AI and SE venues, such as ICSE, FSE, TOSEM, TSE, and ACL, and was recognised with the Google PhD Fellowship in 2023.
